capability: Maintain an evidence-state ledger: label every substantive statement as measured, predicted, inferred, or recommended, and do not change its state during compression or rewriting.
counterexample_or_boundary: A model-derived stress field remains predicted even when it agrees with one experiment; a mechanistic explanation remains inferred unless the link itself was measured or perturbed.

capability: Use a validation firewall: report numerical verification, parameter calibration, independent validation, sensitivity analysis, and application prediction as separate roles, including dataset independence and outcome coverage.
counterexample_or_boundary: Mesh convergence verifies discretization; fitting one group calibrates parameters; agreement with another condition in the same dataset is not automatically independent validation, and validation of ROM does not validate local stress.

capability: Let the highest directly supported evidence rung control the verb: architecture, cell assay, animal tissue response, interface mechanics, and clinical outcome must retain distinct claim strengths.
supporting_journals: Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry
counterexample_or_boundary: ALP, viability, BIC, micro-CT, ISQ, push-in force, and survival answer different questions; none may silently stand in for long-term clinical osseointegration.

capability: Represent implant integration and success as an endpoint vector rather than a single proxy, separating contact, bone amount and pattern, formation rate, interface mechanics, fixation, symptoms, revision, patient-reported function, and durability.
supporting_journals: Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry
counterexample_or_boundary: Absence of revision is not a direct BIC measurement, high BIC is not patient benefit, and an imaging threshold is not fatigue durability.

capability: Before calling a design optimized, state a complete design contract: geometry and provenance, materials, contacts, loads and weights, objective, constraints, variables, non-design regions, regularization, initialization, convergence, comparator, and validation plan.
counterexample_or_boundary: A density field generated under one static load with an unstated filter or inconsistent objective is a conditional numerical solution, not an implant-wide optimum.

capability: Constrain every optimal or superior claim by architecture, dimensions, material and process state, load case, model or species, time point, objective and constraints; present conflicting axes as a Pareto trade-off.
counterexample_or_boundary: Lower mass with higher stress and displacement, or higher porosity with plastic collapse, is a trade-off; it does not support across-the-board performance improvement.

capability: Track topology through distinct states—raw optimization field, reconstructed CAD, manufacturable design, as-built geometry, mechanically tested construct, and biological or clinical application—and quantify loss at every transition.
counterexample_or_boundary: Reanalysis after manual smoothing verifies the reconstructed numerical geometry only; it does not establish print fidelity, fatigue, fixation, bone ingrowth, or clinical performance.

capability: Name material and geometry state at every measurement—CAD, as-printed, cleaned, heat-treated, dehydrated, rehydrated, immersed or aged—and do not transfer properties across states without evidence.
counterexample_or_boundary: Nominal pore size and CAD porosity are not the exposure seen by cells or tissue, and an immersion-conditioned response is not automatically biodegradation.

capability: Keep static strength, stiffness, micromotion, fatigue life, interface fixation and clinical durability separate; claim fatigue safety only with a relevant load history, as-built state, failure definition and test or validated model.
counterexample_or_boundary: A peak von Mises stress below bulk yield strength under one static load does not establish cyclic endurance, screw loosening resistance, defect tolerance or service life.

capability: Decompose patient specificity into geometry, material, load and boundary, implant and contact, pathology, biology, surgical tolerance, workflow and outcome dimensions; state which dimensions are individualized and validated.
counterexample_or_boundary: A database anatomy or patient CT combined with literature materials and generic loads demonstrates geometry personalization only, not a fully patient-specific model or clinical benefit.

capability: For multicomponent interventions, map every component and interaction to a comparator that identifies it; use combined or bundle-associated effect unless a factorial or equivalent design isolates attribution and synergy.
counterexample_or_boundary: Two functions observed in one formulation or improvement during a treatment bundle does not prove component-specific causation or synergy.

capability: Identify article kind before extraction and keep a review's own methods and synthesis separate from outcomes of included studies; use reviews for taxonomy and evidence maps, and retrieve originals for direct effect claims when available.
counterexample_or_boundary: A frequently cited mechanism or animal result inside a narrative review is secondary evidence, and bibliometric prominence is not scientific efficacy.

capability: Audit clinical and device comparators for simultaneous changes in surgical approach, fixation mechanics, selection, workflow, rehabilitation and follow-up; use association language when these factors are not isolated.
counterexample_or_boundary: A custom plate compared with an intramedullary nail changes more than customization; a within-patient site comparison changes anatomy and load; neither identifies a single causal device effect.

capability: Treat null, adverse, failed and contradictory outcomes as first-class evidence: report denominator, time, failure mode and burden alongside favorable endpoints, and use them to bound the mechanism and conclusion.
supporting_journals: Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry
counterexample_or_boundary: Selecting only positive time points, omitting fragile formulations, or treating zero reported complications as zero risk produces an inflated mechanism and translation claim.

capability: Write multiscale mechanisms as design or exposure to mechanics or transport to cell or immune response to tissue to function; label every arrow measured, predicted, inferred or missing and name the perturbation that would distinguish alternatives.
counterexample_or_boundary: Concordant markers, stress maps and tissue formation support a chain but do not prove an unmeasured intermediate; omics and deconvolution remain cues until experimentally perturbed or orthogonally verified.

capability: Use a temporal material-state ledger for degradation claims and require direct mass, molecular, chemical or product evidence before calling immersion-induced swelling, softening, erosion or mechanical change biodegradation.
counterexample_or_boundary: Rehydration, water uptake, reduced stiffness or micro-CT morphology after immersion may reflect reversible conditioning or damage and does not alone identify degradation chemistry or in-vivo resorption.

capability: For algorithms, separate algebraic or theoretical proof, implementation and numerical verification, controlled efficiency benchmarking, physical validation, and biomedical translation; do not let success at one level validate the next.
counterexample_or_boundary: Agreement with another numerical method, an analytical benchmark or a faster run on different hardware verifies limited algorithmic behavior; it does not establish specimen truth, manufacture, fatigue or clinical value.

capability: Audit every lossy computational transformation—filtering, thresholding, local-domain extraction, topology cleanup and manufacturability repair—with thresholds, removed and restored features, boundary artifacts, objective loss and sensitivity.
counterexample_or_boundary: A cleaned topology can lose the raw solution's stress advantage, and a local method can agree on averages while retaining a 17.8% region-specific morphometric error.

capability: In heterogeneous reviews, expose moderators before summarizing direction: study type, species or population, anatomy and defect, intervention form and dose, comparator, fixation, time, endpoint, bias and certainty.
supporting_journals: Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry
counterexample_or_boundary: Study count, intervention frequency or a pooled direction does not create comparability; high heterogeneity and conflicting intervention specificity may require stratified narrative synthesis rather than one effect claim.

capability: Write case reports and treatment bundles as auditable timelines from patient and anatomy through constraint, decision, intervention, complication and dated outcomes; extract a transferable principle while retaining hypothesis-only causal language.
supporting_journals: Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research
counterexample_or_boundary: A successful single case or multimodal regimen supports feasibility and a decision rationale; it does not identify an isolated treatment effect, success rate or general indication.
